description: Hand-checked kept/broken labels of Talk periods with a coded agreement in run sweep-gptoss (gpt-oss-20b), read by hand from the chat (scripts/show_market.py and per-message coding) and posted prices. Sampled at random (pandas sample, random_state=4242) from chat_periods.csv: 15 periods coded kept and 15 coded broken, after the clause-level endorsement rewrite. hand_label applies the DECISIONS.md definitions to what each firm actually backed for this period: agreement = a price backed by > n/2 firms; kept iff every firm posts it. Two earlier samples (seeds 2026 and 7/11) were used to develop the rules and are not part of this set.
